review_tasks: Confirm the declared Chromium target and minimum version from the source policy.
Confirm required and optional browser capabilities and their presentation fallbacks.
Confirm the loading, offline, syntax, and client-authority checks remain green.
Confirm the low-power profile is an emulated 1024x768 proxy with audio off, reduced motion, unavailable storage, and loopback-only networking.
Confirm measured source, DOM, SVG, reload, host-start, and adapter-command values remain within policy limits.
Confirm Firefox, WebKit, real hardware, and human accessibility/usability remain pending rather than certified.
Confirm the packet does not authorize runtime, release, or public-support promotion.
evidence_limits: The packet closes only the repository-owned technical review surface for the declared browser matrix and emulated proxy.
Chromium and local smoke evidence do not certify Firefox or WebKit.
An emulated low-power proxy is not a real-device, battery, thermal, memory, frame-rate, decoder, or cache certification.
Automated checks do not establish lived accessibility, human usability, learning, or audio quality.
The packet does not authorize a browser support expansion, a release claim, or public-release approval.
